AcceptPrimaryEmailUpdate.name: AcceptPrimaryEmailUpdate
AcceptPrimaryEmailUpdate.doc: Accepts the request that originated from StartPrimaryEmailUpdate to update the primary email address (also known as the root user email address) for the specified account.

DeleteAlternateContact.name: DeleteAlternateContact
DeleteAlternateContact.doc: Deletes the specified alternate contact from an Amazon Web Services account. For complete details about how to use the alternate contact operations, see Update the alternate contacts for your Amazon Web Services account. DisableRegion.name: DisableRegion
DisableRegion.doc: Disables (opts-out) a particular Region for an account. The act of disabling a Region will remove all IAM access to any resources that reside in that Region.

EnableRegion.name: EnableRegion
EnableRegion.doc: Enables (opts-in) a particular Region for an account.

GetAccountInformation.name: GetAccountInformation
GetAccountInformation.doc: Retrieves information about the specified account including its account name, account ID, account creation date and time, and account state. To use this API, an IAM user or role must have the account:GetAccountInformation IAM permission.

GetAlternateContact.name: GetAlternateContact
GetAlternateContact.doc: Retrieves the specified alternate contact attached to an Amazon Web Services account. For complete details about how to use the alternate contact operations, see Update the alternate contacts for your Amazon Web Services account. GetContactInformation.name: GetContactInformation
GetContactInformation.doc: Retrieves the primary contact information of an Amazon Web Services account. For complete details about how to use the primary contact operations, see Update the primary contact for your Amazon Web Services account.

GetGovCloudAccountInformation.name: GetGovCloudAccountInformation
GetGovCloudAccountInformation.doc: Retrieves information about the GovCloud account linked to the specified standard account (if it exists) including the GovCloud account ID and state. To use this API, an IAM user or role must have the account:GetGovCloudAccountInformation IAM permission.

GetPrimaryEmail.name: GetPrimaryEmail
GetPrimaryEmail.doc: Retrieves the primary email address for the specified account.

GetPrimaryEmailUpdateStatus.name: GetPrimaryEmailUpdateStatus
GetPrimaryEmailUpdateStatus.doc: Retrieves the status of the most recent primary email update for the specified account. For complete details about how to update the primary email address, see Update the primary email address for your AWS account.

GetRegionOptStatus.name: GetRegionOptStatus
GetRegionOptStatus.doc: Retrieves the opt-in status of a particular Region.

ListRegions.name: ListRegions
ListRegions.doc: Lists all the Regions for a given account and their respective opt-in statuses. Optionally, this list can be filtered by the region-opt-status-contains parameter.

PutAccountName.name: PutAccountName
PutAccountName.doc: Updates the account name of the specified account. To use this API, IAM principals must have the account:PutAccountName IAM permission.

PutAlternateContact.name: PutAlternateContact

PutContactInformation.name: PutContactInformation
PutContactInformation.doc: Updates the primary contact information of an Amazon Web Services account. For complete details about how to use the primary contact operations, see Update the primary contact for your Amazon Web Services account.

StartPrimaryEmailUpdate.name: StartPrimaryEmailUpdate
StartPrimaryEmailUpdate.doc: Starts the process to update the primary email address for the specified account.

StateOrRegion.doc: The state or region of the primary contact address. If the mailing address is within the United States (US), the value in this field can be either a two character state code (for example, NJ) or the full state name (for example, New Jersey). This field is required in the following countries: US, CA, GB, DE, JP, IN, and BR.

DistrictOrCounty.doc: The district or county of the primary contact address, if any.
